categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Changes `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp` and `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, modifying the C API boundary functions `btck_block_check` and `btck_chainstate_manager_process_block`.
categories.rationale: Fixes a correctness bug where validating a block under one set of parameters contaminates subsequent validation calls. In the libbitcoinkernel C API, `fChecked` on the underlying `CBlock` allowed an invalid block (such as a regtest block checked under mainnet parameters) to erroneously pass `btck_block_check`, and also mutated state without holding `cs_main`.
